tools.name: list_clinics
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which dental practices they run in DodoDentist, or a practice's id is needed. Returns each practice's id, name, currency, default language and timezone, 20 per page by default. Not for looking up a patient or appointment.

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one dental practice's setup, such as its currency, language or timezone. Returns the practice's name, currency, default language, timezone and last edit time. Not for free appointment times.

tools.name: get_clinic_availability
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their dental practice has free appointment times or the next available slot. Returns each open online-booking slot's start and end, grouped by day, for the next days with openings: up to 7 days and 100 slots (no patient or dentist details). Not for booking or holding

tools.name: list_clinic_providers
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which dentists, dental nurses or assistants patients can book at their practice, or which one to book a patient with. Returns up to 100 staff ids and display names for one practice (no contact details or roles). Not for staff holidays or days off.

tools.name: get_clinic_schedule_summary
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how busy their dental practice is or how many appointments are booked each day. Returns appointment counts per UTC day for one practice, whatever their status, for the next 7 days by default and at most 31 days; counting stops at 100. Not for counting cancellations or seei

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what their dental practice charges for a treatment, such as a cleaning, filling, crown or whitening, or which treatment to book. Returns catalog treatment ids and names with price and last edit time, alphabetically, 50 per page by default. Not for a patient's treatment his

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their dental practice is closed, or when a dentist or chair is blocked for holidays, courses, meetings or maintenance. Returns each block or extra opening with start, end, all-day flag, scope and type (no titles or notes). Not for patient appointments.

tools.name: find_patient
tools.description: Use this when someone names a patient to book, move, cancel or update, and the patient's id is needed. Returns up to 5 patients whose name holds every word given, with id, name, practice and edit time, plus the last two phone digits when two share a name. Not for listing, browsing or counting patien

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when a patient is booked or what is booked on a day, or an appointment id is needed to move or cancel it. Returns up to 50 appointments in start order with id, patient and provider ids, times, status and edit time, for one day or one patient. Not for counting how busy days

tools.name: list_inventory_items
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much of a supply is left in their dental practice's stock or what is running low. Returns up to 100 stock items with unit, quantity, minimum and a low-stock flag. Not for treatment prices.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to book a patient in at their dental practice. Returns the new appointment with its time, providers and how many procedures it holds; it takes the practice's usual length, seat and reminders, so the practice's reminder messages go to the patient. Not for finding free slots

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to move a patient's appointment to another day or time. Returns the moved appointment; its patient, providers, procedures and length stay the same and the patient's reminders move with it. Not for cancelling an appointment.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to cancel a patient's appointment. Returns the appointment as canceled, kept rather than deleted, and whether the practice's cancellation message goes to the patient. Not for moving an appointment to another time.

tools.name: create_patient
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to add a new patient to their dental practice. Returns the patient's id, name, practice and language; the phone and email given are saved but never returned, and nothing clinical is taken. Not for changing an existing patient.

tools.name: update_patient
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to change a patient's name, phone, email or language. Returns the patient's id, name, practice and which fields changed; contact details are never returned. Not for clinical records or adding a new patient.

tools.name: set_inventory_quantity
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to correct or update how much of a stock item the practice has. Returns the item with its previous and new quantity; the number given replaces the stored one. Not for adding a new stock item.

tools.name: show_clinic_overview
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a quick overview or dashboard of one dental practice. Returns an overview card with the practice's details, appointment counts for the next 7 days, how many staff take bookings, open online-booking slots and up to 12 treatment prices (no patient or clinical data). Not for

tools.name: open_dododentist
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to open DodoDentist and browse their clinics, aggregate schedule counts, booking availability and procedure prices in an interactive sidebar. Returns up to 100 clinics to start from (no patient records, individual appointments, contact details or clinical data). Not for b

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_clinic_providers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when someone asks which dentists, dental nurses or assistants patients can book at their practice. Returns up to 100 staff display names for one practice (no contact details or roles). Not for staff holidays or days off." → after: "Use this when someone asks which dentists, dental nurses or assistants patients can book at their practice, or which one to book a patient with. Returns up to 100 staff ids and display names for one practice (no contact details or roles). Not for staff holidays or days off."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
